ayahs.tr: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak"
ayahs.hint: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of the dawn...

ayahs.tr: From the evil of what He created
ayahs.hint: From the evil of what He created...

ayahs.tr: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
ayahs.hint: And from the evil of darkness...

ayahs.tr: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
ayahs.hint: And from the evil of blowers...

ayahs.tr: And from the evil of an envier when he envies
ayahs.hint: And from the evil of an envier...
